items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with a walk of 10 to 19 minutes getting most of the gain. If you take insulin or a sulfonylurea, ask your care team about low sugar before adding walks after meals.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Having dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a rise in sugar, with dinners at 8-9 pm linked to a bigger rise than earlier ones. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see how it affects you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Averaging an overnight fast of 11.7 hours may have an effect, but it is not clear yet from the checks in real people. In the program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed the result by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
